basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a 26-year-old from Austin, Texas. I recently became fascinated with cryptocurrencies and have been exploring the world of Bitcoin. I work as a junior software developer and spend my free time gaming and learning about blockchain technology. I'm single and enjoy hiking on weekends. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science from the University of Texas, which sparked my interest in technology and cryptocurrencies. I am self-teaching myself about crypto through online courses and forums like Reddit.
